variants.name: Pork 400 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Fresh is tasty meat chunks in a delicate pate. The recipe is based on 50 years of experience in food production. It is a complete and balanced food for adult dogs. The fresh pork meat content guarantees the high biological value of the recipe.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meat and derivatives (fresh meat; pork 26% and pork liver 17%), cereals, oils and fats, mineral substances, powdered milk protein.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 7.5% - Crude fibre: 0.5% - Crude fats: 6.0% - Crude ash: 2.5% - Moisture: 79%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 450 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopherol-acetate) 15 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.04 mg/kg) 0.018 mg/kg, Manganese (Manganous sulphate monohydrate 9 mg/kg) 2.9 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 32 mg/kg): 25.7 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 3.5 mg/kg) 0.89 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate15 mg/kg) 4.93 mg/kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 1.8 mg/kg) 1.17 mg/kg.
